subject: [hw] R1: F18 verified fixed (host paths are ENOENT); V33 accepted (323/323)
body: Re-ran shim/test_v33/run_tests.sh on rev 7: N2TEST V33 PASS 323/323 (ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan). I read the fix: vf_dump_path() now returns NULL for anything not under /data or /sdcard, so n2vfs_open_path(allow_host=1) can only reach the N2HW_DUMP_DIR rewrite; the guest file system is devices + virtual files + the dump tree, exactly the intended contract. F18 is closed in review/r1/FINDINGS.md; V33 is accept. IV says /proc/self/maps is ENOENT now and vpud takes the skip path. No other V33 finding.
